note: Independent re-judgment after BGP export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified RFC 7311 Section 3.4.3 ('Then, when R1 changes the next hop of a route from R2 to R1, the AIGP TLV value MUST be increased by a non-zero amount.'), forward_aigp.go (aigpIncrement, sourceAIGPLinkMetric, applyFactsAIGP), peer_forward_facts.go (precomputeNextHop), and all four tagged tests. Following the migration from PeerSettings.NextHopMode to ExportPolicyWithNextHop (setExportNextHopSelf / setExportNextHopUnchanged) in TestRFC7311SourceLinkCostReachesRecipient and newAIGPReplayFixture, static next-hop:self and next-hop:unchanged resolve identically through precomputeNextHop and applyEgressNextHopIntent. Q1: TestRFC7311DirectLinkCostNeverWrapsOrDisappears and TestAIGPForwardedMetricsReachFinalWire require direct-link cost 7 to emit exact wire metric 107 with no IGP route and withdraw on absent/zero cost; TestRFC7311SourceLinkCostReachesRecipient verifies source costs 7 and 19 (vs destination cost 43) across general and RS-cached rails plus unchanged-next-hop 100 controls and saturation; TestRFC7311UnknownCostWithdrawsUntilMetricRecovers verifies withdrawal/withholding on unknown/zero cost and exact recovery to 111 when distance 11 becomes known. Q2: omitting the increment, reading destination cost instead of source cost, announcing without a non-zero cost, or modifying AIGP on unchanged next hop all fail exact wire metric, NEXT_HOP, frame count, and withdrawal checks. Q3: unresolved igpcost.Lookup, differing source/destination costs, explicit accepting policies, and source-buffer immutability isolate the rule. Q4: covers direct-link non-zero accumulation, source-link provenance on both rails, zero/missing refusal, and recovery.
